cards.title: String methods
cards.body: Strings come with built-in tools called methods. Call one with a dot: `word.upper()` gives a capitalised copy, `word.lower()` a lowercase one.

hi.title: String methods
hi.body: Strings ke saath built-in tools aate hain jinhe methods kehte hain. Unhe dot se call karo: `word.upper()` capital letters wali copy deta hai, `word.lower()` small letters wali.

cards.title: Methods return a new string
cards.body: `upper()` does not change the original. It gives back a new string, which you can join to more text with `+`.

hi.title: Methods nayi string dete hain
hi.body: `upper()` original ko nahi badalta. Yeh ek nayi string wapas deta hai, jise aap `+` se aur text ke saath jod sakte ho.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: Type `HELLO` and it prints `HELLO`, not `hello`. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: `lower()` gives back a new string and leaves `word` as it was. Keep the result: `word = word.lower()`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: `HELLO` type karo toh yeh `hello` nahi, `HELLO` hi print karta hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: `lower()` nayi string deta hai aur `word` ko waisa hi chhod deta hai. Result ko rakho: `word = word.lower()`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: upper() turns every letter into a capital. The space stays a space.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: upper() har letter ko capital bana deta hai. Space, space hi rehta hai.

exercise.prompt: Read a line of text and print it in capital letters followed by `!`. For `hello`, print `HELLO!`
exercise.promptHi: Text ki ek line padho aur use capital letters mein print karo, aakhir mein `!` ke saath. `hello` ke liye `HELLO!` print karo.
